verbatim: You have full autonomy to acquire and procure all power rankings, advanced data, and any other advanced metric and/or data sets, including statistics and season assistance and all available statistics you are able to acquire on the [entire] Internet. You have autonomous support moving forward. Please pull roster status, injury status, depth charts, and any other player metrics or data that improves accuracy.
scope: STANDING (durable, 'moving forward'): acquire public sports data — power ratings, advanced/team/player metrics, rosters, depth charts, injury/rest status, lineups, statistics — to improve model accuracy.
constraints_held_regardless: R1 — acquire REAL data from identifiable sources and FREEZE it with provenance (source, URL, retrieved_utc, confidence). Never invent a player, stat, status, or number. Under-report before fabricating; low-quality returns are flagged/omitted, not laundered in (cf. the WebSearch '5-2 records' that were rejected).
NETWORK — use only sanctioned channels (WebSearch first-party; WebFetch where permitted). The org egress proxy 403s are policy and are NEVER routed around.

R3/R6 — do NOT silently mutate frozen models or already-published cards. New data enters as versioned inputs + reconciliation sidecars; any model that consumes it is a new hashed identity, not a rewrite.

MONEY/GATE — this authorization is for DATA ONLY. It does not authorize wagers, does not move the ML gate (0/100 NO_PROMOTE), and does not touch the ledger ($0). Push still requires separate explicit authorization.
PROVENANCE HIERARCHY — official box/league > reputable outlet (ESPN/Rotowire/beat) > aggregator; user positions remain user-authoritative; conflicts recorded, not silently resolved.
landing_layer: data/feeds/{mlb,wnba}/ with per-pull artifacts; data/feeds/MANIFEST.json documents schema + sources.
